rereport.closure_text: Case Closed. Closed date : 2016-07-25 12:00:27.65 Case Resolved Dear Constituent     The PWD Roadway Repair Contractor is working on your street performing patch paving.    It is an important city service for your neighborhood to provide the best permanent repairs of previous utility excavations or potholes.    The construction process is to dig out 6.5 inches of material and place 5 inches of dense binder hot mix asphalt in 2 lifts. The dense binder gives the patch its strength but is has large stones and is not conducive to providing a smooth ride  the contractor usually within a week comes back and places 1.5 inches of  the top course. The top course is hot mix asphalt  that provides the smooth ride.    The street is leafleted before the work begins where it explains that it is a mufti phase construction operation and you should look at the dates since they will change as each construction phases progresses.    Our goal is to allow parking between phases and not post the street for the entire time the work takes place. This is why the contractor repeatedly changes the dates.  We spoke to the contractor about his need to be totally accurate when posting and leafleting for upcoming work.    Since this is a patching contract  the contractor may only be on your street for only a short period of time; giving the appearance of not showing up.    Sometimes poor weather  plant breakdowns  or equipment failure occurs which results in the delay of the upcoming work.    The CIU spoke to the contractor about his need to do a better job on changing the dates when those situations arise.    Any questions you call the City Engineer Marty Lee at [removed]     The city apologizes for the inconvenience this necessary work has caused.
